## Frequently asked questions

### What’s included in my Trial plan?

Trial is a renewable plan that lets you test Snov.io tools before you commit to a paid plan. On trial you can search for leads, verify emails, warm up your sender account, send campaigns and manage deals in the CRM. You will get 50 credits, 100 recipients, and 1 email warm-up slot. Premium features like integrations, bulk search, bulk verification, teamwork, email A/B testing, API & webhooks access and export are not available in Trial.

### When does my Trial plan end?

You can use your Trial plan for as long as you like. Your free credits and recipients renew every 30 days. Please note that the Trial plan has been created to offer a peek into what Snov.io can do and is not meant to help grow sales. To see actual sales growth and get the most out of Snov.io tools, we recommend upgrading to a plan that actually fits your business needs.

### Can I try LinkedIn Automation for free?

Yes, you can! All users on plans Starter and higher can access a free 7-day trial of LinkedIn Automation.

### Is Snov.io right for my business?

Snov.io was built for businesses and agencies of all sizes. As long as you want to grow your sales and improve your workflow, Snov.io is for you. If you’re hesitating and would like to find out more, [book a short call](https://calendly.com/d/2y5-ybf-2q9) with us to discuss specific problems you’re looking to solve with Snov.io.

### What is a credit?

Credit is a payment unit exchanged for [Email Finder](https://snov.io/email-finder) and [Verifier](https://snov.io/email-verifier) services. You can distribute your credits between the tools as you like. [Find out more](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/what-is-a-credit/).

### What is a recipient?

Recipient is a payment unit in the [Drip Campaigns tool](https://snov.io/email-drip-campaigns). 1 recipient is charged when you first contact a lead. All follow-ups to that lead in the same billing period are free and unlimited. [Find out more](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/recipients/).

### How can I spend my credits and recipients?

Each prospect found, email verified and company profile viewed costs 1 credit. You can also use credits to [check your deliverability](https://snov.io/email-deliverability-test) \- 25 credits per check that includes email placement test and DNS record check. Drip Campaigns tool uses your recipient quota, with unlimited follow-ups to each prospect contacted that month. Your number of [email warm-up](https://snov.io/email-warm-up) slots depends on your plan, with Pro plans offering unlimited warm-up.

### Do credits cost less on larger plans?

Yes! The larger the plan - the less you pay per credit and per recipient. For example one credit on our Starter plan costs 3.9¢ while on one of our most popular Pro M plans it’s only around 0.9¢ (over x4 less!). Your price per lead changes drastically depending on your plan, so consider getting a larger plan if you’re choosing between two.

### Does Snov.io really have unlimited campaigns?

Yes. With Snov.io you are only limited in recipients according to your plan of choice. With each plan you have unlimited campaigns, unlimited follow-ups, and unlimited sender account slots - perfect for automating and scaling your outreach!

### Does Snov.io integrate with the other tools I use?

Most likely yes! Snov.io offers a variety of native integrations as well as over 5,000 Zapier and Make integrations. You can view just a fraction of the integrations we offer [here](https://snov.io/integrations).

### Which tools does Snov.io offer?

Snov.io offers over a dozen sales tools and extensions for prospecting, LinkedIn lead generation, email verification, email engagement tracking, outreach, email warm-up and sales management. You can view the full list of our tools and features by clicking See all plan features above.

### Can I export my collected data from Snov.io?

Yes, Snov.io offers unlimited export on all plans except Trial.

### How can I pay for my plan?

All payments are processed by a third-party payment processing service. It currently offers the following options:

- Visa
- MasterCard
- Discover
- American Express
- Diners
- JCB
- PIN debit cards with Visa or MasterCard
- debit cards with Visa or MasterCard
- PayPal

and others depending on your country.

### Can I cancel, upgrade or downgrade anytime?

Yes, you can! Upgrading and downgrading is easy, you can read more about it [here](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/upgrade-downgrade-plan/).

### Do you offer demos?

Yes! [Book a quick call with us](https://calendly.com/d/2y5-ybf-2q9) to find out more about what Snov.io can do for your business.

### I have more questions.

We’re always here to help! Don’t hesitate to drop your questions in the chat or email us at [help@snov.io](mailto:help@snov.io) :)

# Plans overview

Whether you’re just getting started, growing your business or already have many contacts to work with, Snov.io has an affordable pricing bundle for you. We offer several pricing plans, including Trial, Starter, Pro (Pro S, Pro M, Pro L, Ultra) and Custom Ultra plans.

[Trial](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/pricing-plans-overview/#trial)

[Starter plan](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/pricing-plans-overview/#starter)

[Pro plans](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/pricing-plans-overview/#pro)

## **Quotas**

Each plan includes a toolset and a specific number of account quotas:

- [Credits](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/what-is-a-credit/): can be used for prospect search and email verification, distributed as you choose. [Unused credits](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-keep-unused-credits-on-your-balance/)roll over to the next month with plan autorenewal in any premium plan
- [Unique recipients](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/recipients/): used to contact leads in a campaign or individually. You are charged for a recipient only once a month, with unlimited free follow-ups included
- [Email warm-up slots](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/warm-up-slots-and-warm-up-volume-limits/): the number of email accounts you can warm up at the same time to improve delivery and protect sender reputation
- [LinkedIn slots](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/faq-linkedin-addon-billing/) for LinkedIn Automation (available as an add-on with all premium plans): used to connect your LinkedIn accounts to run multichannel campaigns

Snov.io offers both **monthly and annual billing**, with the same tools and quotas across each plan tier.

![learn](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/themes/knowledgebase-n/assets/img/fluent_chat-warning-16-regular.svg)

If you're planning ahead, **annual billing** gives you full access to all features at a lower cost — **25% less** than monthly plans.

And the higher the plan tier, the greater the savings. You can always upgrade if your outreach volume is growing.

Depending on your business needs, choose one of our existing plans or opt for a custom solution.![](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Snovio-plans-6-1.png)

## **Plans**

Here's a quick summary of our plans to help you choose the best fit.

### **Trial**

![note](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/themes/knowledgebase-n/assets/img/ph_circle-wavy-warning.svg)

Trial plan is ideal for beginners who want to try out our prospecting features and create their first email campaign.

**On balance:**

- **50 credits**: equal to 50 [Domain Searches](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-addresses-from-a-domain/) or 50 [collected prospects from LinkedIn](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-install-li-prospect-finder-chrome-extension/), or 50 [email verifications](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-verify-emails/)— credits are reset each month
- **100 recipients**: valid for contacting 100 leads, with unlimited follow-ups
- **1 mailbox warm-up**: enables you to add 1 email account for [warm-up](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-start-warming-up-your-mailbox-with-snov-io/) and provides a one-time free quota of 450 warm-up emails upon sign-up. It is non-renewable and once used up, you'll need to upgrade to continue using the Email Warm-up feature

**What’s included in Trial plan:**

- [Domain Search](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-addresses-from-a-domain/): includes domain search, single email search, database search, email finder extension and LinkedIn prospect finder extension, excluding only Pro bulk search
- [Email Verifier](https://app.snov.io/verify/individual-emails): check email validity status to get an average deliverability of 98%
- [Email Campaigns](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-create-a-drip-campaign-step-by-step/): send automated email sequences with follow-up conditions to your prospects
- [Email Warm-up](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-start-warming-up-your-mailbox-with-snov-io/): grow your sender reputation and fix email delivery issues
- [Sales CRM](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/what-is-snov-io-crm/): create pipelines and deals, assign and manage tasks
- [Deliverability Check](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-test-and-improve-email-deliverability/): detect and solve any issues with email deliverability
- [Email personalization:](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-add-variables-to-emails/) insert placeholders for a prospect’s details into your cold email templates
- [Multiple email sender accounts](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/connect-your-mailbox/): add them for full control over your account’s settings and performance
- [Unlimited follow-ups](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-add-a-delay-between-follow-up-emails/): engage recipients who haven’t responded to your initial message
- [Multiple campaigns](https://snov.io/blog/how-to-send-automated-email/): automate outreach and scale sales with personalized email sequences

**Which features are not part of the Trial plan?**

Trial plan doesn’t include:

- Unlimited emails/uploaded contacts/team seats/mailbox rotation
- Integrations like API & Webhooks, Hubspot, Pipedrive, Calendly, Zapier and more
- Bigger monthly warm-up volume
- Bulk email search and bulk verification
- Campaign priority and volume control
- Unused credits rollover
- LinkedIn Automation
- Spintax for human-like campaigns
- CRM Teamwork
- Dynamic Content
- Email Verifier (API)
- Email AI assistant
- Email A/B testing
- Data export

## **Starter plan**

![note](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/themes/knowledgebase-n/assets/img/ph_circle-wavy-warning.svg)

Starter is a perfect paid plan to kick off sales and set up your prospecting and outreach.

**On balance:**

- **1,000 credits**: equal to 1,000 [Domain Searches](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-addresses-from-a-domain/), emails from 500 domains with [Bulk Domain Search](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-addresses-from-a-list-of-domains/), 1,000 [verified prospects from LinkedIn](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-li-prospect-finder-chrome-extension/) or 1,000 [email verifications](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-the-bulk-email-verification-tool/).You can mix and match these credits across various tools
- **5,000 recipients**: reach 5,000 prospects monthly through email or [multichannel campaigns](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-create-a-drip-campaign-step-by-step/). Engage directly via each prospect's profile and get maximum flexibility for one-on-one interactions beyond campaigns
- **3 mailbox warm-ups**: add up to [3 email accounts for warm-up](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-start-warming-up-your-mailbox-with-snov-io/), paying per slot, not per account. Choose which accounts to warm up and manage slots weekly, with no extra cost for switching accounts

**What’s included in plan:**

Includes **all the basic features** from above **,** plus these **premium features**:

- Use [LinkedIn Automation](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-snov-io-linkedin-automation/): purchased as an add-on to run email or multichannel (email + LinkedIn) campaigns and automatically visit profiles, like posts, send connection requests and messages
- Bulk prospecting and saving: find emails from [list of domains](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-addresses-from-a-list-of-domains/) and [LinkedIn URL list](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-contacts-from-a-list-of-links-to-social-network-profiles/), as well as process multiple LinkedIn profiles and save them in bulk
- [Bulk email verification:](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-the-bulk-email-verification-tool/) verify up to 1,000 emailsat once and clean your contact list from fake and unreachable leads
- [Integrations](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/integrations/): sync with tools like HubSpot, Pipedrive, Calendly, Google Calendar and 5,000 other apps via Zapier and Make
- [REST API](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-snov-io-api/): integrate directly to Snov.io platform, track campaigns, verify emails, manage prospects, retrieve email addresses from the database and many other functions to optimize your workflow
- Data export: download [prospect lists](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-export-emails-from-snovio/) and [campaign reports](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-view-and-download-campaign-reports/) in the preferred format
- 24-hour support: get the best customer care team, always there to help you

**On Starter plan, you’ll also be able to**:

- Unlock bulk search within [Email Finder](https://snov.io/email-finder) and [LinkedIn](https://snov.io/linkedin-email-finder) prospecting extensions for Chrome,with no limitations compared to the Trial plan
- Add email accounts to [mailbox rotation](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-mailbox-rotation-to-increase-sending-limit/) and use multiple email accounts in a single campaign to increase the total daily sending limit
- [Connect custom tracking domain](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-set-up-your-custom-tracking-domain/) to use it exclusively for tracking opens, clicks, and unsubscribes in your emails
- Use [Email AI](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/email-ai-overview-how-to-write-emails-with-ai-powered-assistant/) to review your copy and improve it to get maximum impact
- [Track link clicks](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-track-clicks-on-a-link-in-email-campaigns/) for better engagement analysis and reduce the chance of your emails being flagged by Gmail
- Insert [Calendly link](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-set-up-a-calendly-integration/) directly into the message and create alternative flows for leads
- Set up [engagement notifications](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-browser-notifications-when-recipients-engage-with-your-emails/) to follow up right after a prospect shows interest

If you need **Teamwork functions**, check the next plan tier: every **Pro** or **Custom Ultra** plan includes unlimited team members and full [teamwork functionality](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-does-the-teamwork-feature-function/).

Starter plan offers a taste of essential features for nurturing and engaging leads. To get more advanced tools and really see your growth, upgrade to Pro.

## **Pro Plans**

![note](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/themes/knowledgebase-n/assets/img/ph_circle-wavy-warning.svg)

The main perk of Pro plans — Snov.io offers Pro S, Pro M, Pro L and Pro Ultra — is their scalability. Choose the plan that fits your sending needs and rest assured, there’s always room to grow.

**Top features on Pro plans:**

- Unlimited mailbox warm-ups
- Greater monthly warm-up volume
- Fully loaded LinkedIn Automation
- Advanced A/B testing
- Campaign volume and priority control
- Dynamic Content
- Full functionality of teamwork
- Access to all integration tools

How to choose the perfect plan? Base it on your team size, outreach needs and campaign goals. All Pro Plans offer 24-hour priority support and personal 1-on-1 calls with an implementation manager if you need any help. ![](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Snovio-Pro-Plans.png)

![note](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/themes/knowledgebase-n/assets/img/ph_circle-wavy-warning.svg)

**On balance:** each Pro pricing plan offers progressively more credits and recipients as you move up the tiers.

- **Credits:** can be used for [Domain Searches](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-addresses-from-a-domain/), getting emails from domains with [Bulk Domain Search](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-get-email-addresses-from-a-list-of-domains/), verifying prospects from LinkedIn or [email verifications](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-the-bulk-email-verification-tool/)
- **Recipients**: contact prospects monthly via email or [multichannel campaigns](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-snov-io-linkedin-automation/)
- **Unlimited mailbox warm-ups:** add an unlimited number of [email accounts](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-start-warming-up-your-mailbox-with-snov-io/) for a warm-up

Includes **all features from Starter plan,** plus:

- [A/B testing campaigns](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-send-a-b-testing-campaigns/): test email variants to find out which performs best
- [Campaign priority](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-set-sending-priority-in-email-campaigns/) and [volume control](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-set-daily-limits-in-campaigns/) for new recipients
- [Spintax](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-spintax-variables-for-better-email-deliverability/): feature that randomizes word choices in your emails for better deliverability
- [Dynamic Content](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-personalize-emails-with-dynamic-content/): make your emails more effective with variables for email personalization
- [Teamwork](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-does-the-teamwork-feature-function/): share prospect data and credits, control permissions and track statistics per team member

![](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/snovio-plans-2.png)

## **Add-ons**

### **LinkedIn Automation add-on**

To get better results with less effort, use automation to scale your LinkedIn outreach. Need more convincing?

- **Increased outreach efficiency**

**Benefit**: LinkedIn Automation lets you add profile views, follows, connection requests and messages to your sequences.

**Outcome**: You reach a larger audience through an additional channel, do it faster and without manual management of each interaction.

- **Enhanced personalization & improved conversion rates**

**Benefit**: Automatically personalize your connection requests and follow-up messages with variables, making your outreach more engaging and efficient.

**Outcome**: Your communication always stays personalized and you get better engagement and more replies.

- **Scalability of outreach efforts & time savings**

**Benefit**: LinkedIn Automation cuts down time spent on repetitive tasks like sending connection requests and follow-ups while still scaling your outreach.

**Outcome**: You can free up time for other high-priority tasks, like nurturing relationships, closing deals or refining your sales strategy.

With Snov.io LinkedIn Automation, you get a built-in location-based proxy, IP location change, daily action limits, Spintax, message personalization, a Reports dashboard and way more. Learn [how to use it](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/how-to-use-snov-io-linkedin-automation/) and change the way your outreach works.

LinkedIn Automation is available as an add-on with any premium plan. Add LinkedIn slots to your order — each slot costs $69 and connects one LinkedIn account, even with our Starter plan. You’ll need a LinkedIn slot for each account to use multiple accounts simultaneously for different campaigns.

When deciding which plan is right for you, consider the size of your team, your outreach volume expectations, and the features that matter most to your sales process.

You can change your plan anytime you need to adjust your workflow or increase your outreach. Make sure to review how your quotas and billing are affected [when upgrading or downgrading your plan](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/upgrade-downgrade-plan/).

Go to the [pricing page](https://snov.io/pricing) to select the plan that will help you maximize your results with ease!

If you have a question that we haven't covered, feel free to reach out to our Customer Care team. You can contact us at help@snov.io or through live support chat.

web.markdown:
**On this page**

**Snovio** positions itself as a complete outreach platform, offering everything from email discovery and verification to multichannel campaign automation and deliverability tools. It’s built for teams that want to manage outreach in one place instead of stitching together multiple tools.

But are Snov.io's features reliable? How does it integrate to other tools? And is it worth the cost compared to tools like Skrapp.io, Kaspr, and Apollo?

In this review, I’ll cover what Snov io does well, where it falls short, and how it stacks up in a crowded field of B2B lead gen platforms. Real user reviews, product testing, and pricing breakdowns are included.

**Quick Summary**

- **Pricing**: Starts at $39/month with free plan available
- **Data Accuracy**: ★★★★☆ (4.5/5) — Clean email data, but limited database
- **Ease of Use**: ★★★★☆ (4.4/5) — Intuitive for most, slight learning curve
- **Features**: ★★★★☆ (4.0/5) — Solid outreach tools, CRM, email warmup
- **Integrations**: ★★★★☆ (4.3/5) — Native CRM, Gmail, LinkedIn extensions
- **Customer Support**: **★★★★☆**(3.9/5) — Inconsistent user reviews
- **Pricing Value**: ★★★★☆ (4.1/5) — Affordable but costly per lead

[Find emails while you scroll – Try Skrapp for LinkedIn](https://skrapp.io/linkedin)

## Snov.io Overview

![Snovio dashboard, review 2025](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Reports-01-21-2025_11_27_AM.png)

_**Editor’s Note:** Our reviews are based on independent research and hands-on testing. We evaluate platforms like Snov.io using real user feedback, pricing transparency, feature scope, and competitive positioning. This guide aims to help buyers make informed software decisions without the noise._

Snov.io is an all-in-one sales engagement platform designed to streamline lead generation and outreach workflows. Founded in 2017, it started as a simple email finder but has since expanded into a more robust platform offering multichannel automation, CRM, and email deliverability tools. It’s aimed at teams that want to simplify their tech stack by combining prospecting and outreach capabilities without jumping between multiple tools.

[Don’t pay for bad data – Try Skrapp instead](https://skrapp.io/email-finder)

## Snov.io Main Features

Snov.io combines lead generation, outreach automation, and deliverability into a single interface. The platform is structured around modular tools that support prospecting, multichannel outreach, and CRM workflows. Here’s how each feature functions in practice

### Email Finder & Verification

![snovio bulk email finder, snovio review 2025](https://snov.io/images/pages/bulk-email-finder/hero-image.png)

Snov.io’s email finder lets users search for leads by domain, job title, or company. The system supports single or bulk searches, and includes a 7-tier verification process to help reduce bounce rates. Graylisting bypass and an API for live verification add flexibility for developers or advanced teams.

The database offers verified emails, although multiple users report that the breadth of data is limited—especially for niche industries or less-populated regions.

### Multichannel Campaigns

![snovio multichannel tools , snovio review 2025](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Snov-io-2024-05-20T191027.550.jpg)

The platform allows you to build automated outreach sequences across email and LinkedIn. These flows can include smart triggers based on user actions, such as email opens, clicks, or LinkedIn visits. The visual campaign builder is flexible, but some users note that setup can be complex for non-technical users.

### Deliverability & Email Warm-Up

![Snov.io - Email Warm-up dashboard, snovio 2025 review](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/New-warm-up-campaign-02-17-2025_03_52_PM.png)

To boost inbox placement, Snovio includes a native email warm-up engine. It simulates conversations, rotates templates, and gradually increases sending volume. This is especially useful for new domains or accounts launching outbound campaigns from scratch. These features help users avoid spam folders, although advanced teams may still rely on external tools for more granular reputation tracking.

### Built-in CRM

![Snov.io CRM dashboard, 2025 snovioreview](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/01.png)

Snov.io includes a basic CRM to manage leads, notes, deal stages, and tasks. It’s helpful for solo users or early teams, but may feel limited for organizations with more complex sales ops. Larger teams typically sync Snovio with HubSpot, Pipedrive, or Salesforce to centralize contact management.

> _➡️ **Features Rating:** ★★★★☆ (4.0/5) Snov.io delivers a broad mix of prospecting, outreach, and CRM features. It's flexible for small teams, but some limitations in ease of use and data scope may require external tools as teams grow._

[Find emails straight from LinkedIn — try Skrapp’s Chrome extension now](https://skrapp.io/linkedin)

## Snov.io Integrations

![snovio integrations 2025](https://snov.io/knowledgebase/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Integrations.png)

Snovio connects with several tools to help you streamline prospecting and outreach workflows. While it covers basic needs, the overall integration offering is narrower than what some competitors provide—especially for larger teams or marketing-driven operations.

### CRM Integrations

Snov.io offers direct integrations with:

- **HubSpot**
- **Salesforce**
- **Zoho CRM**
- **Pipedrive**

### Email & Productivity Tools

- **Gmail** and **Outlook**: Enable sending emails and tracking opens/clicks directly from your account.
- **Google Sheets**: Supports list imports and exports for lead management and enrichment.
- **Zapier**: Opens up additional integrations with over 1,000+ apps.

While this makes it possible to create workflows between Snov.io and other platforms, the need for Zapier can add friction for teams expecting deeper native integrations.

### Browser Extension & Scraper

Snov.io includes a Chrome extension for LinkedIn and domain-based prospecting. However, users have flagged frequent disruptions when scraping LinkedIn, including issues with login sessions and occasional platform-wide outages. These bugs may interrupt prospecting workflows, especially for users relying on LinkedIn data extraction.

> ➡️ **Integration Rating**: ★★★★ (4.1/5) Snov.io integrates with major CRMs and productivity tools, making it viable for most small-to-mid-sized teams. Still, reliance on Zapier and platform reliability issues may limit it for users needing seamless, real-time data flows.

[Use Skrapp to turn LinkedIn searches into verified contact lists](https://skrapp.io/linkedin)

## Snov.io Customer Support
